context_title:
az asztrológiai adatok maradnak! a teljes kódot kijavítva vissza küldöd. minden egyes karaktert leírsz, nem rövidítesz. minden hibát kijavítasz. egy fájl marad. ne írj semmi mást csak a teljes kódot es kommentek nem lehetnek benne! soha semmi egyszerusitett mock placeholder dummy szimulalt fake szart nem engedelyezek es teljes fájl roviditetlen production ready kód 
javítsd az összes hibát! jelenlegi hibák:


Enum.zip_with hibás aritással van hívva; a helyes forma Enum.zip_with([basis, coeffs], fun) vagy Enum.zip/2 → map, a jelenlegi hívás fordítási hibát okoz. 
- b_spline_basis rekurzióban indexelési hiba: i+degree+1 és i+1 kilóg a knots/prev_basis tartományából, Enum.at nil-t ad, majd aritmetika nil-lel fut (runtime kivétel). 
- b_spline_basis hibás hosszkezelés: a basis hossza fok növelésekor sem változik, nem követi a Cox–de Boor formulát, így a kan_spline_eval eleve inkonzisztens. 
- kan_spline_eval-ben a basis és a coeffs hossza eltér (basis tipikusan 4 elem, coeffs grid=5), ezért a súlyozott összeg elemeket veszít; a rossz zip_with hívás miatt amúgy is fordítási hiba. 
- hybrid_tokenize-ban a spline_x az eredeti text hosszával oszt (String.length(text)) ahelyett, hogy a normalizált norm hosszát használná; a két hossz eltérhet, így a skálázás hibás. 
- GenServer.start_link névregisztrációval (name: __MODULE__) indul; a main másodszori hívásakor {:error, {:already_started, pid}} jön, a {:ok, pid} mintaillesztés összeomlik. 
- System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) / 1_000_000.0 hibás időskála; milliszekundumot másodpercre 1_000‑rel kell osztani, nem 1_000_000‑ral. 
- b_spline_basis-ben a nevezőellenőrzés sorrendje hibás: a különbségek kiszámítása (nil-lel is) a “!= 0.0” vizsgálat előtt történik, így kivételt okoz. 
- lorenz_embedding List.duplicate(0.0, @dim - 9) negatív ismétlésszám esetén kivételt dob; a kód @dim ≥ 9 feltételt hallgatólag feltételez. 
- A B-spline csomópontvektor nincs “clamped” (szélső csomópontok nincsenek ismételve), fok 3 mellett ez hibás bázisfüggvényeket és indexelést eredményez. 
- kan_spline_eval knots generálása i / (grid - 1) 0-val oszthat, ha grid=1; nincs robusztus védelem az osztás ellen.
	•	In the b_spline_basis function, the recursive case uses Enum.map(0..(length(prev_basis) - 1), ...) but accesses Enum.at(prev_basis, i + 1), causing an out-of-bounds error for the last i.
	•	In the kan_spline_eval function, the length of coeffs (which is grid) does not match the number of basis functions for degree 3 (which is grid - 4), leading to a length mismatch in Enum.zip_with.
	•	In the hybrid_tokenize function, the grapheme is bound to _ and ignored, so embeddings depend only on index, not on the text content.
	•	In the hybrid_tokenize function, spline_x = index / String.length(text), but text is the original string while processing is on norm and its graphemes, potentially inconsistent if lengths differ.
	•	In the lorenz_embedding function, parameters id and index are used distinctly, but in hybrid_tokenize, id is set to index, making them identical.
	•	The spline_coeffs field in the state is initialized but never used or updated in the code.
	•	The memories and cache fields in the state are initialized but never used in the code.
- b_spline_basis (degree > 0): Enum.at(prev_basis, i + 1) index túlcsordulás az utolsó iterációnál
- b_spline_basis (degree > 0): Enum.at(knots, i + degree) és Enum.at(knots, i + degree + 1) túllépi a knots lista határát
- b_spline_basis (degree = 0): Enum.at(knots, i + 1) túlcsordulhat
- kan_spline_eval: grid számú knot van, de degree=3 esetén grid+4 knot szükséges
- kan_spline_eval: basis és coeffs listák hossza eltér, Enum.zip_with hibát okoz
- hybrid_tokenize: üres text esetén String.length(text) = 0, osztás nullával
- lorenz_embedding: @dim < 9 esetén List.duplicate(0.0, @dim - 9) negatív argumentum
- hybrid_tokenize: birth lista üres lehet, rem(index, length(birth)) osztás nullával


defmodule JAIDE.V33.ElixirActor do
  use GenServer
  @dim 18432
  @grid 5
  @pi :math.pi
  def start_link(_) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, %{memories: %{}, current_state: %{potential: 0.0, quantum_phase: 0.0, timestamp: System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) / 1_000_000.0, spline_coeffs: List.duplicate(List.duplicate(0.0, @grid), @dim)}, cache: %{}}, name: __MODULE__)
  end
  def init(state) do
    {:ok, state}
  end
  def lorenz_embedding(id, index) do
    sigma = 10.0
    rho = 28.0
    beta = 8.0 / 3.0
    dt = 0.01
    x0 = id * 0.1
    y0 = index * 2.0
    z0 = 0.0
    x1 = x0 + dt * (sigma * (y0 - x0))
    y1 = y0 + dt * (x0 * (rho - z0) - y0)
    z1 = z0 + dt * (x0 * y0 - beta * z0)
    phase = :math.sin(x1) * :math.cos(y1) * :math.sin(z1)
    sin_phase = :math.sin(phase)
    cos_phase = :math.cos(phase)
    [phase, sin_phase, cos_phase, sigma, rho, beta, x1, y1, z1] ++ List.duplicate(0.0, @dim - 9)
  end
  def b_spline_basis(x, knots, degree) do
    if degree == 0 do
      Enum.map(0..(length(knots) - 2), fn i ->
        if x >= Enum.at(knots, i) and x < Enum.at(knots, i + 1) do 1.0 else 0.0 end
      end)
    else
      prev_basis = b_spline_basis(x, knots, degree - 1)
      Enum.map(0..(length(prev_basis) - 1), fn i ->
        term1 = if Enum.at(knots, i + degree) - Enum.at(knots, i) != 0.0 do (x - Enum.at(knots, i)) / (Enum.at(knots, i + degree) - Enum.at(knots, i)) * Enum.at(prev_basis, i) else 0.0 end
        term2 = if Enum.at(knots, i + degree + 1) - Enum.at(knots, i + 1) != 0.0 do (Enum.at(knots, i + degree + 1) - x) / (Enum.at(knots, i + degree + 1) - Enum.at(knots, i + 1)) * Enum.at(prev_basis, i + 1) else 0.0 end
        term1 + term2
      end)
    end
  end
  def kan_spline_eval(x, coeffs, grid) do
    knots = Enum.map(0..(grid - 1), fn i -> i / (grid - 1) end)
    basis = b_spline_basis(x, knots, 3)
    Enum.sum(Enum.zip_with(basis, coeffs, &(&1 * &2)))
  end
  def hybrid_tokenize(text, grid, birth) do
    norm = text |> String.downcase() |> String.replace("-", " ") |> String.replace("  ", " ") |> String.trim()
    graphs = String.graphemes(norm)
    Enum.with_index(graphs) |> Enum.map(fn {_, index} ->
      id = index
      lorenz = lorenz_embedding(id, index)
      degree = Enum.at(birth, rem(index, length(birth)))
      phase_shift = :math.sin(index * 0.1 + degree)
      lorenz_shift = Enum.map(lorenz, &(&1 + phase_shift))
      spline_x = index / String.length(text)
      coeffs = List.duplicate(1.0, grid)
      spline_val = kan_spline_eval(spline_x, coeffs, grid)
      emb = Enum.map(lorenz_shift, &(&1 + spline_val * 0.01))
      %{id: id, embedding: emb}
    end)
  end
  def handle_cast({:update_state, token, grid}, state) do
    sum_emb = Enum.sum(token.embedding)
    new_potential = state.current_state.potential + sum_emb * 0.01 * :math.log(@dim * grid)
    new_phase = state.current_state.quantum_phase + @pi / 180.0
    updated_state = %{state.current_state | potential: new_potential, quantum_phase: new_phase, timestamp: System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) / 1_000_000.0}
    {:noreply, %{state | current_state: updated_state}}
  end
  def main do
    {:ok, pid} = start_link(nil)
    text = "JAIDE V33 Elixir actor"
    birth = [25.52, 18.58, 15.27]
    tokens = hybrid_tokenize(text, @grid, birth)
    for token <- tokens do
      GenServer.cast(pid, {:update_state, token, @grid})
    end
    IO.puts "Hybrid Elixir Actor Loaded for JAIDE V33 LLM"
  end
end

defmodule JAIDE.V33.ElixirActor do
  use GenServer
  @dim 18432
  @grid 5
  @degree 3
  @pi :math.pi
  def start_link(_) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, %{memories: %{}, current_state: %{potential: 0.0, quantum_phase: 0.0, timestamp: System.monotonic_time(:second) * 1.0, spline_coeffs: List.duplicate(List.duplicate(0.0, @grid), @dim)}, cache: %{}}, [])
  end
  def init(state) do
    {:ok, state}
  end
  defp safe_duplicate(val, n) when is_integer(n) and n > 0 do
    List.duplicate(val, n)
  end
  defp safe_duplicate(_val, _n) do
    []
  end
  def lorenz_embedding(id, index) do
    sigma = 10.0
    rho = 28.0
    beta = 8.0 / 3.0
    dt = 0.01
    x0 = id * 0.1
    y0 = index * 2.0
    z0 = 0.0
    x1 = x0 + dt * (sigma * (y0 - x0))
    y1 = y0 + dt * (x0 * (rho - z0) - y0)
    z1 = z0 + dt * (x0 * y0 - beta * z0)
    phase = :math.sin(x1) * :math.cos(y1) * :math.sin(z1)
    sin_phase = :math.sin(phase)
    cos_phase = :math.cos(phase)
    base = [phase, sin_phase, cos_phase, sigma, rho, beta, x1, y1, z1]
    pad = safe_duplicate(0.0, @dim - length(base))
    base ++ pad
  end
  defp clamped_uniform_knots(grid, degree) when grid >= 1 and degree >= 0 do
    interior_count = max(grid - degree - 1, 0)
    left = List.duplicate(0.0, degree + 1)
    right = List.duplicate(1.0, degree + 1)
    interior =
      if interior_count > 0 do
        Enum.map(1..interior_count, fn k ->
          k / (interior_count + 1)
        end)
      else
        []
      end
    left ++ interior ++ right
  end
  defp b_spline_basis_deg0(x, knots) do
    n = length(knots) - 1
    last_index = n - 1
    Enum.map(0..last_index, fn i ->
      ki = Enum.at(knots, i)
      kip1 = Enum.at(knots, i + 1)
      cond do
        ki == nil or kip1 == nil ->
          0.0
        x >= ki and x < kip1 ->
          1.0
        x == 1.0 and kip1 == 1.0 ->
          1.0
        true ->
          0.0
      end
    end)
  end
  def b_spline_basis(x, knots, degree) when degree == 0 do
    b_spline_basis_deg0(x, knots)
  end
  def b_spline_basis(x, knots, degree) when degree > 0 do
    prev = b_spline_basis(x, knots, degree - 1)
    m = length(prev) - 1
    Enum.map(0..m, fn i ->
      ki = Enum.at(knots, i)
      kid = Enum.at(knots, i + degree)
      kip1 = Enum.at(knots, i + 1)
      kid1 = Enum.at(knots, i + degree + 1)
      bi = Enum.at(prev, i)
      bip1 = Enum.at(prev, i + 1)
      a_num = if ki == nil or kid == nil, do: 0.0, else: x - ki
      a_den = if ki == nil or kid == nil, do: 0.0, else: kid - ki
      a =
        if a_den != 0.0 do
          (a_num / a_den) * (if bi == nil, do: 0.0, else: bi)
        else
          0.0
        end
      b_num = if kip1 == nil or kid1 == nil, do: 0.0, else: kid1 - x
      b_den = if kip1 == nil or kid1 == nil, do: 0.0, else: kid1 - kip1
      b =
        if b_den != 0.0 do
          (b_num / b_den) * (if bip1 == nil, do: 0.0, else: bip1)
        else
          0.0
        end
      a + b
    end)
  end
  def kan_spline_eval(x, coeffs, grid) do
    g = if is_integer(grid) and grid >= 1, do: grid, else: max(length(coeffs), 1)
    deg = @degree
    knots = clamped_uniform_knots(g, deg)
    basis0 = b_spline_basis(x, knots, deg)
    n_basis = g + deg
    basis =
      cond do
        length(basis0) == n_basis ->
          basis0
        length(basis0) > n_basis ->
          Enum.take(basis0, n_basis)
        true ->
          basis0 ++ List.duplicate(0.0, n_basis - length(basis0))
      end
    coeffs_fixed =
      cond do
        length(coeffs) == n_basis ->
          coeffs
        length(coeffs) > n_basis ->
          Enum.take(coeffs, n_basis)
        true ->
          coeffs ++ List.duplicate(0.0, n_basis - length(coeffs))
      end
    Enum.zip(basis, coeffs_fixed) |> Enum.map(fn {b, c} -> b * c end) |> Enum.sum()
  end
  def hybrid_tokenize(text, grid, birth) do
    norm = text |> String.downcase() |> String.replace("-", " ") |> String.replace("  ", " ") |> String.trim()
    graphs = String.graphemes(norm)
    glen = length(graphs)
    blen = max(length(birth), 1)
    Enum.with_index(graphs)
    |> Enum.map(fn {g, index} ->
      id = index
      lorenz = lorenz_embedding(id, index)
      deg = Enum.at(birth, rem(index, blen)) || 0.0
      phase_shift = :math.sin(index * 0.1 + deg)
      lorenz_shift = Enum.map(lorenz, fn v -> v + phase_shift end)
      denom = max(glen - 1, 1)
      spline_x = index / denom
      coeffs = List.duplicate(1.0, grid)
      spline_val = kan_spline_eval(spline_x, coeffs, grid)
      emb = Enum.map(lorenz_shift, fn v -> v + spline_val * 0.01 end)
      %{id: id, ch: g, embedding: emb}
    end)
  end
  def handle_cast({:update_state, token, grid}, state) do
    sum_emb = Enum.sum(token.embedding)
    new_potential = state.current_state.potential + sum_emb * 0.01 * :math.log(@dim * grid)
    new_phase = state.current_state.quantum_phase + @pi / 180.0
    updated_state = %{state.current_state | potential: new_potential, quantum_phase: new_phase, timestamp: System.monotonic_time(:second) * 1.0}
    {:noreply, %{state | current_state: updated_state}}
  end
  def main do
    case Process.whereis(__MODULE__) do

        {:ok, pid} = start_link(nil)

defmodule JAIDE.V33.ElixirActor do
  use GenServer
  @dim 18432
  @grid 5
  @degree 3
  @pi :math.pi
  def start_link(_) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, %{memories: %{}, current_state: %{potential: 0.0, quantum_phase: 0.0, timestamp: System.monotonic_time(:second) * 1.0, spline_coeffs: List.duplicate(List.duplicate(0.0, @grid), @dim)}, cache: %{}}, name: __MODULE__)
  end
  def init(state) do
    {:ok, state}
  end
  defp safe_duplicate(val, n) when is_integer(n) and n > 0 do
    List.duplicate(val, n)
  end
  defp safe_duplicate(_val, _n) do
    []
  end
  def lorenz_embedding(id, index) do
    sigma = 10.0
    rho = 28.0
    beta = 8.0 / 3.0
    dt = 0.01
    x0 = id * 0.1
    y0 = index * 2.0
    z0 = 0.0
    x1 = x0 + dt * (sigma * (y0 - x0))
    y1 = y0 + dt * (x0 * (rho - z0) - y0)
    z1 = z0 + dt * (x0 * y0 - beta * z0)
    phase = :math.sin(x1) * :math.cos(y1) * :math.sin(z1)
    sin_phase = :math.sin(phase)
    cos_phase = :math.cos(phase)
    base = [phase, sin_phase, cos_phase, sigma, rho, beta, x1, y1, z1]
    pad = safe_duplicate(0.0, @dim - length(base))
    base ++ pad
  end
  defp clamped_uniform_knots(grid, degree) when grid >= 1 and degree >= 0 do
    interior_count = max(grid - degree - 1, 0)
    left = List.duplicate(0.0, degree + 1)
    right = List.duplicate(1.0, degree + 1)
    interior = if interior_count > 0 do
      Enum.map(1..interior_count, fn k -> k / (interior_count + 1) end)
    else
      []
    end
    (left ++ interior ++ right) |> List.to_tuple()
  end
  defp b_spline_basis_deg0(x, knots_tuple) do
    n = tuple_size(knots_tuple) - 1
    last_index = n - 1
    Enum.map(0..last_index, fn i ->
      ki = elem(knots_tuple, i)
      kip1 = elem(knots_tuple, i + 1)
      cond do
        x >= ki and x < kip1 -> 1.0
        x == 1.0 and kip1 == 1.0 -> 1.0
        true -> 0.0
      end
    end)
  end
  def b_spline_basis(x, knots_tuple, degree) when degree == 0 do
    b_spline_basis_deg0(x, knots_tuple)
  end
  def b_spline_basis(x, knots_tuple, degree) when degree > 0 do
    prev = b_spline_basis(x, knots_tuple, degree - 1)
    prev_tuple = List.to_tuple(prev)
    m = tuple_size(prev_tuple) - 1
    knots_max = tuple_size(knots_tuple) - 1
    Enum.map(0..m, fn i ->
      ki = if i <= knots_max, do: elem(knots_tuple, i), else: 0.0
      kid_idx = i + degree
      kid = if kid_idx <= knots_max, do: elem(knots_tuple, kid_idx), else: 0.0
      kip1_idx = i + 1
      kip1 = if kip1_idx <= knots_max, do: elem(knots_tuple, kip1_idx), else: 0.0
      kid1_idx = i + degree + 1
      kid1 = if kid1_idx <= knots_max, do: elem(knots_tuple, kid1_idx), else: 0.0
      bi = if i <= m, do: elem(prev_tuple, i), else: 0.0
      bip1 = if kip1_idx - 1 <= m, do: elem(prev_tuple, kip1_idx - 1), else: 0.0
      a_num = x - ki
      a_den = kid - ki
      a = if a_den != 0.0, do: a_num / a_den * bi, else: 0.0
      b_num = kid1 - x
      b_den = kid1 - kip1
      b = if b_den != 0.0, do: b_num / b_den * bip1, else: 0.0
      a + b
    end)
  end
  def kan_spline_eval(x, coeffs, grid) do
    g = if is_integer(grid) and grid >= 1, do: grid, else: max(length(coeffs), 1)
    deg = @degree
    knots_tuple = clamped_uniform_knots(g, deg)
    basis0 = b_spline_basis(x, knots_tuple, deg)
    n_basis = g + deg
    basis = cond do
      length(basis0) == n_basis -> basis0
      length(basis0) > n_basis -> Enum.take(basis0, n_basis)
      true -> basis0 ++ List.duplicate(0.0, n_basis - length(basis0))
    end
    coeffs_fixed = cond do
      length(coeffs) == n_basis -> coeffs
      length(coeffs) > n_basis -> Enum.take(coeffs, n_basis)
      true -> coeffs ++ List.duplicate(0.0, n_basis - length(coeffs))
    end
    Enum.zip(basis, coeffs_fixed) |> Enum.map(fn {b, c} -> b * c end) |> Enum.sum()
  end
  def hybrid_tokenize(text, grid, birth) do
    norm = text |> String.downcase() |> String.replace("-", " ") |> String.replace("  ", " ") |> String.trim()
    graphs = String.graphemes(norm)
    glen = length(graphs)
    blen = max(length(birth), 1)
    birth_tuple = List.to_tuple(birth)
    Enum.with_index(graphs) |> Enum.map(fn {g, index} ->
      id = index
      lorenz = lorenz_embedding(id, index)
      deg = elem(birth_tuple, rem(index, blen))
      phase_shift = :math.sin(index * 0.1 + deg)
      lorenz_shift = Enum.map(lorenz, fn v -> v + phase_shift end)
      denom = max(glen - 1, 1)
      spline_x = index / denom
      coeffs = List.duplicate(1.0, grid)
      spline_val = kan_spline_eval(spline_x, coeffs, grid)
      emb = Enum.map(lorenz_shift, fn v -> v + spline_val * 0.01 end)
      %{id: id, ch: g, embedding: emb}
    end)
  end
  def handle_cast({:update_state, token, grid}, state) do
    sum_emb = Enum.sum(token.embedding)
    new_potential = state.current_state.potential + sum_emb * 0.01 * :math.log(@dim * grid)
    new_phase = state.current_state.quantum_phase + @pi / 180.0
    updated_state = %{state.current_state | potential: new_potential, quantum_phase: new_phase, timestamp: System.monotonic_time(:second) * 1.0}
    {:noreply, %{state | current_state: updated_state}}
  end
  def main do
    case Process.whereis(__MODULE__) do
      nil ->
        {:ok, _pid} = start_link(nil)
        text = "JAIDE V33 Elixir actor"
        birth = [25.52, 18.58, 15.27]
        tokens = hybrid_tokenize(text, @grid, birth)
        for token <- tokens do
          GenServer.cast(__MODULE__, {:update_state, token, @grid})
        end
        IO.puts("Hybrid Elixir Actor Loaded for JAIDE V33 LLM")
      _pid ->
        text = "JAIDE V33 Elixir actor"
        birth = [25.52, 18.58, 15.27]
        tokens = hybrid_tokenize(text, @grid, birth)
        for token <- tokens do
          GenServer.cast(__MODULE__, {:update_state, token, @grid})
        end
        IO.puts("Hybrid Elixir Actor Loaded for JAIDE V33 LLM")
    end
  end
end
